title: Hard object found in nostril during 2001 nasal surgery

tellings.quote: Well, uh, in 2001, I believe it was, um, I was having breathing problems. I had a deviated septum. So, I finally had some nasal surgery.

plain: Richard Barth, a former guard at a nuclear missile site who says he was abducted by aliens, tells Michels that in 2001 he had surgery for a deviated septum and a hard object was found in his nostril. He tells it from his own life, as a man who had been having breathing problems. Told alongside his abduction story, it suggests the object could be something placed in him.
